data.one_liner: Environment-specific configuration and .env file generator for Flutter and Dart builds.
data.what_it_does: Generates a Dart configuration class and optional .env files based on environment configuration specified during CI/CD builds or command line execution. It supports patterns, defaults, and global environment variables.
use_when: You need to inject environment-specific variables during CI/CD builds without async file reading.
You want to automatically generate both a Dart config class and a .env file from a YAML schema.
avoid_when: You are using Flutter 1.17 or higher and prefer native compile-time variables over a package generator.
You need to obfuscate or fully secure highly sensitive credentials from reverse engineering.
strengths: Sync reading of configuration values to decrease app start time.
Supports custom field patterns, default values, and global environment variables.
Can generate both Dart classes and .env files simultaneously.
weaknesses: Does not obfuscate or encrypt config values by default.
Flutter developers on version 1.17+ are advised to use built-in compile-time variables instead.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dependency, create an environment_config.yaml file, and run the generator command via CLI.
data.minimal_example:
environment_config:
  path: environment_config.dart
  class: EnvironmentConfig
  fields:
    some_key:
      type: String
      default: 'default_value'
